sobre.title: About me
sobre.p1: I am an Information Technology and Software Development professional with 5+ years of experience in IT Coordination, Front-End Development and Technical Support (L1 to L3). I work across the full lifecycle of solutions and services — from requirements and planning to implementation, monitoring and user support.
sobre.p2: In development, I build web applications, internal systems and real-time dashboards with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, Ionic, React, HTML and SCSS, focusing on performance, accessibility and process automation. In IT/Operations, I have experience with SLA management, GLPI, Zabbix, Windows Server, Active Directory, corporate networks and asset management.
sobre.studying: Currently studying: Docker, Node.js, C# and expanding my toolkit to deliver increasingly complete solutions.
